title: Story premise ENT002: One Sock, Maximum Drama
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: One sock up. One career down. Takeaway/theme: A constraint can become a deliberate style choice.
description: A performer must step onto a stage with matching socks, but each attempt to pull up one oversized sock pulls the other down through an absurd shared elastic. The performer finally rolls both cuffs into identical ankle bands and presents the accidental costume with confidence.
